title: 9" Large Mesh Strainer, Stainless Steel 18/8 Extra Fine Quinoa Sieve, with Solid Sturdy Handle, Flour Filter with Wider Hook
description:
About this item
Food Grade Stainless Steel 18/8 Construction: Our kitchen strainer is made of first class Stainless Steel 18/8 304 that is BPA free, Lead and Cadmium free. It is rust free and will never affect the taste of your food!
30 Mesh Extra Fine Strainer: Our extra fine sieve is 30 mesh and two layers of tightly woven. It is great for filtering fine grains like quinoa, flour, rice and sugar.
Riveted and Solid Stainless Steel Handle: Wider hook with 2 rivets to avoid slipping. Solid stable handle with 2 rivets, never bend or break! These make our strainer strong enough.
Large Capacity: Our 9" strainer with deep bowl can collect more food. With its large capacity, you can use like a colander to drain pasta or sift larger quantities.
Lifetime Guarantee: We are so confident in the quality of our strainer that we offer you a lifetime guarantee. Reach out to us if there’s ever anything you need; we are dedicated to your satisfaction.
